messages.author: Yang Wei
messages.body:

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Mar 15, 2024, Yang Wei via AMBER wrote:
>The GB and PB components performed satisfactorily, but encountered issues
>during quasi-harmonic calculations. Any insights or suggestions you can
>provide would be greatly appreciated.
How many snapshots did you use for the quasi-harmonic calculation?  How many
atoms in your system?
This is just a guess, but having too few snapshots is an easy mistake to
make.
....dac
